Blueberry Smoothie
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:39am

Ingredients




1 pint fresh blueberries
cup (or 2  [10 oz] frozen blueberries, slightly thawed)
1 cup pineapple, orange, (or pineapple-orange juice)
1 ct lowfat vanilla yogurt - (8 oz)
2 teaspoons sugar

Preparation

1 In a container of an electric blender combine blueberries, juice, yogurt and sugar. Blend until smooth, about 1 minute. 2 Serve immediately in tall glasses. Garnish with blueberry skewers spiraled with thin strips of orange peel, if desired. 3 This recipe yields 1 serving.
